description: This header file defines utility classes and objects for testing within the ocudu namespace, including custom log sinks, test delimiters, and test objects for move and copy semantics.

classes.name: log_sink_spy
classes.description: A custom log sink that counts error and warning log entries.

classes.name: log_sink_message_spy
classes.description: A custom log sink that stores log entries and allows checking for specific messages.

classes.name: test_delimit_logger
classes.description: A utility class that outputs delimiters around test logs for clarity.

classes.name: moveonly_test_object
classes.description: A test object to verify move constructor and move assignment semantics.

classes.name: copyonly_test_object
classes.description: A test object to verify copy constructor and copy assignment semantics.

classes.name: nondefault_ctor_test_object
classes.description: A simple test object with a non-default constructor.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the identifier name of the custom sink.

methods.name: get_error_counter
methods.description: Returns the count of error log entries.

methods.name: get_warning_counter
methods.description: Returns the count of warning log entries.

methods.name: reset_counters
methods.description: Resets error and warning counters to zero.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Processes a log buffer, updating counters based on log level.

methods.name: has_message
methods.description: Checks if a specific message exists in the logged entries.

methods.name: test_delimit_logger
methods.description: Outputs delimiters for test start and end.

methods.name: moveonly_test_object
methods.description: A class to test move semantics, tracking object count.

methods.name: copyonly_test_object
methods.description: A class to test copy semantics, tracking object count.

methods.name: nondefault_ctor_test_object
methods.description: A simple class with a non-default constructor.
